_readme: Survivors of the matrix mutation sweep. 'classified' = an EQUIVALENT mutant: no input or state can make it behave differently; needs a reason of at least 20 characters containing the argument. 'open' = a known weakness, neither fixed nor equivalent; it does not fail the sweep (so a regression is visible) but it keeps the matrix at PASS_PARTIAL. A fingerprint is sha256(module|operator|original line text) truncated to 16 hex, so it survives unrelated edits and dies with the line it names.

classified.reason: ifPrefix loop bound `w >= 0` vs `w > 0`: the two differ only when every character before the `(` is whitespace. The real code then slices an empty string and the mutant slices one whitespace character; neither can match the identifier regex, so both return null, and `w` is not read afterwards. When bl[0] is not whitespace both loops stop in the identical state. Argued independently by the triage agent (4M exhaustive and 5M random inputs, 0 differences), a verifier, and by hand.

open.note: Found by the 2026-11-03 baseline sweep (seed 20261102, N=24, stable sample). Not triaged: neither fixed nor shown equivalent. A weakness in the module's own checks until a person classifies it.
